in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitrangda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is skilled in painting, arts, and crafts. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘chitra’ meaning picture or painting and ‘angda’ meaning skilled or expert.
